[METRIC DEFINITIONS]
- IoU: Intersection over Union
- Dice: 2 * Intersection / (Sum of masks)
- Precision: TP / (TP + FP)
- Recall: TP / (TP + FN)
- F1: Harmonic mean of Precision and Recall
- AP_Foreground: Average Precision for foreground class
- AP_Background: Average Precision for background class
- mAP: (AP_Foreground + AP_Background) / 2
